title: Pricing-change projection
description: Deterministic derived pricing-change records from canonical Signal current/history data: observed records only from material differences between consecutive published snapshots, upcoming records only from source statements that explicitly declare a future-effective time. Every record preserves before/after values, dimension and condition identity, verbatim notes, times only when safely available, and source provenance. Never a second truth source.

schemaVersion.description: Changes contract major version; a breaking change is a new contract version.

records.description: Change records in deterministic order: observed (by publishedAt) then upcoming (by signalId).

signalId.description: Stable identity of the canonical Signal this record is projected from.

model.description: Product-owned model label, for example 'Gemini 3.7 Flash'.

kind.description: 'observed' = already seen in canonical history; 'upcoming' = explicitly declared future-effective by the source.

observedAt.description: When the later snapshot of an observed change was observed.

publishedAt.description: When the later snapshot of an observed change was published.

effectiveAt.description: Effective time of an upcoming change, present only when the verbatim source note normalizes safely to a full UTC instant.

url.description: Official source URL the canonical Signal was derived from.

fetchedAt.description: When the source content was fetched.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the fetched source content, for reproducible verification.

name.description: Stable pricing dimension name, for example input-price-cache-hit.

unit.description: Rate unit; v1 covers per-1M-token usage rates.

before.description: Statements before the change, in canonical order; empty when the dimension was added.

after.description: Statements after the change, in canonical order; conditional after values (e.g. off-peak and peak) are never flattened. Empty when the dimension was removed.

value.description: Numeric rate per unit, in the statement's currency.

note.description: Verbatim source qualifier, for example 'starting January 1, 2027.'.

after.note: peak (01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC (all other hours are off-peak)) from 16:00 UTC on August 16, 2026
